pako deterministic gzip codec
=============================

Upstream: https://github.com/nodeca/pako
Package:  pako@1.0.11
Artifact: npm package `pako-1.0.11.tgz`, published `dist/pako.min.js`
Source:   https://registry.npmjs.org/pako/-/pako-1.0.11.tgz
Reviewed: 2026-08-17
License:  MIT AND Zlib (see LICENSE and ZLIB-LICENSE)

The vendored `pako.min.js` is byte-identical to the published npm artifact.
`pako.esm.js` is deterministically generated by `scripts/vendor-pako-esm.mjs`:
the environment-detecting UMD wrapper is removed, while the upstream codec
factory body remains byte-for-byte unchanged. `index.js` only re-exports its
named ESM bindings. This avoids globals, runtime evaluation, and the ambiguous
CommonJS detection that made the upstream UMD unsafe to browser-bundle.

Integrity:
  npm lock integrity: sha512-4hLB8Py4zZce5s4yd9XzopqwVv/yGNhV1Bl8NTmCq1763HeK2+EwVTv+leGeL13Dnh2wfbqowVPXCIO0z4taYw==
  pako.min.js sha256: 29cfa0542b9864b6640cfdcc8f15b184db6431b532db2702a3ce97e5f2a7fc1c
  pako.esm.js sha256: e565e4757a1519428a2463f056f2423117afbc2cdb72af22c10bff653bd5ae1d
  LICENSE sha256:     a04665b3b2de56c66730c1f720f528175739e4104f79073614aa611da1e85539

why vendored: dwapp v2 hashes and signs the compressed representation. Native
CompressionStream implementations are allowed to choose different valid
DEFLATE encodings, which can change a content address across browser/runtime
versions. Pako's version-pinned JavaScript algorithm plus the codec parameters
signed into the descriptor make the stored bytes reproducible on every host.

Update procedure:
  1. Pack the exact new pako version into a temporary directory.
  2. Audit its package metadata, distribution delta, and license delta.
  3. Copy the published full UMD bundle, update this file and both licenses,
     then update the pinned upstream hash in `scripts/vendor-pako-esm.mjs`.
  4. Run `bun run vendor:pako`, review the one-wrapper transform, and update
     the explicit codec identity/options in shared/bundle/transport.js.
  5. Deliberately change the golden compressed hash in both Bun and browser
     transport tests after reviewing the byte-level protocol change.
  6. Run `bun packaging/check-vendor.ts --write` in the same change.
